Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production painted 2D character sprite sheet for Rootward Voxel, transparent RGBA.
Input image role: the supplied boy's 3-by-3 sheet is the STRICT POSE, SCALE, CAMERA, STYLE AND GRID REFERENCE. Repaint every figure as the SAME new village resident Rowan, the millwright.
Identity: An older man, warm tan skin, silver swept-back hair, short neat silver beard and bushy eyebrows, teal waistcoat over cream rolled sleeves, rust neckerchief, charcoal trousers and chestnut boots. Friendly experienced face; no hat.
Keep the reference's cute roughly three-head-tall proportions, apparent height, boot size and full-body silhouette scale; adult identity is expressed through face, hair and clothing, not realistic proportions.
NON-NEGOTIABLE ANIMATION TEMPLATE: 1254x1254 square image, exactly nine equal 418x418 cells in 3 columns and 3 rows. Reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom, preserve each corresponding reference frame's precise stance, supporting foot, boot sole angle, arm swing, head direction and body position. Frames 1-8 are the existing eight walk phases. Frame 9 bottom right is neutral standing with planted feet and relaxed arms. All nine figures face front-right / southeast in the same elevated three-quarter view. Preserve distinct raised/passing foot gestures in cells 3,4,6,7,8. This is an appearance repaint of all nine poses, not a replacement walk cycle.
Style: Match the reference's polished painterly storybook/chibi sprite exactly: bold dark brown outlines, softly painted faceted highlights, expressive face, warm light, crisp readable forms. Consistent identity and clothes in every cell.
Constraints: transparent background, empty hands, no floor, no cast shadows, no labels, no text, no grid borders, no extra props or weapons. One full character per cell. No clipped heads or boots. Preserve pose order, grid, viewpoint and frame count.
ne:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent painted animation sheet, 1254x1254 pixels, 3x3 grid of nine 418x418 cells.
Input image 1 is the boy's BACK-RIGHT nine-pose sheet: strict camera, pose, cell layout and scale reference. Input image 2 is Rowan's new FRONT-RIGHT sheet: exact identity, clothes, colors, proportions and painting-style reference.
Repaint every corresponding pose in image 1 as Rowan, the village millwright, seen from behind. Identity: An older man, warm tan skin, silver swept-back hair, short neat silver beard and bushy eyebrows, teal waistcoat over cream rolled sleeves, rust neckerchief, charcoal trousers and chestnut boots. Friendly experienced face; no hat.
All nine figures face away and to the RIGHT, northeast/back-right in the same elevated three-quarter camera as image 1. No front-facing face or visible front eyes. Match image 2's hair and clothing from behind; keep its exact coat length, colors and boot design. Frames 1-8 walk and frame 9 is neutral standing. Preserve all corresponding foot support, raised boot sole angles, arm swings, body positions and nine different gestures from image 1 in the same reading order. Empty hands, original roughly three-head-tall chibi proportions and apparent height.
Style: image 2's polished storybook painted sprite, bold dark brown outlines, warm faceted highlights and crisp expressive forms. No realistic proportions.
Constraints: transparent RGBA background, ample transparent gaps between cells, one full figure per cell, no crop, no ground/shadow, labels, borders, text, weapons or extra props. Keep the 3x3 grid exactly. Do not restore the original boy's orange spiky hair.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Edit target: the attached 250x250 head-and-shoulders crop of Rowan, the village millwright.
Change ONLY both open eyes to gently closed eyes. Replace the whites and pupils with matching local facial skin, with thin relaxed dark curved eyelid lines at exactly the current eye positions. A neutral 120 ms blink, not smiling, squinting, laughing or sleeping.
Preserve the exact face, hair, eyebrows, nose, mouth, beard or spectacles if present, skin tone, clothes, pose, camera, scale, pixel placement and transparent alpha. Keep brass spectacle rims unchanged for Nell. No changes outside the eyes. Transparent RGBA, one edited crop, no letters, borders, shadows or added objects.
